citations.quote: Unsere Tochter (5), die wegen ihres Asthmas ohnehin empfindlich ist, hat seither öfter Anfälle.
An der Decke im Bad wächst grau-grüner Schimmel, und im Gang riecht es muffig.
Wir brauchen deshalb unbedingt eine unabhängige Fachperson, die die Ursache feststellt, sonst dreht sich das endlos im Kreis.
Wenn sich bis Ende November nichts tut, zahle ich die Miete bei der Hinterlegungsstelle ein und nicht mehr an die Immo Jura.

plan.because: Needed to establish the parties, property and tenancy terms.
The defect report to the landlord and its date are not supplied.
Landlord receipt of the defect report and its date need evidence.
Dated objective evidence of the affected locations is needed.
The reported landlord position, any proposed work and access arrangements need documenting.
Mould is reported; dated moisture and temperature observations are relevant.
Heating is unmentioned. Although its factual verdict is unresolved, the silence policy presumes this branch absent for planning.
Increased asthma attacks are reported; documented findings and limits on any attributed cause are relevant.
An independent specialist is requested and the cause is disputed. If no report exists, arrange assessment rather than assume a cause.
Rent deposit is contemplated; the communicated deadline, recipient and notice contents need checking.
This is optional under the process.

questions: Are the child's symptoms currently urgent or severe? If so, seek prompt medical help; an acute breathing emergency requires immediate emergency assistance.
When did the mould and odour first appear, and when and how was the landlord notified? Please provide the notice and evidence of receipt.
What has the landlord proposed or done, and have inspection or repair access arrangements been discussed?

Has a written repair deadline been sent to the landlord, and which year does the proposed end-of-November deadline refer to? Do not assume a rent deposit is permissible before its safeguards are checked.
Is an independent inspection report already available, or does an inspection still need to be arranged?
